{{Quote|It's because we work and we work and we don't get greensick. No other mining village on Lanteeb can claim that. They don't know our secret. Not Chukba, not Endvo, not Deebin, not even Trahn.|[[Jaklin]]|<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Siege" />}}
'''Deebin''' was a [[Damotite]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] settlement that was located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]]. During the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] occupation of Lanteeb during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the inhabitants of Deebin were at a disadvantage to the rival mining village [[Torbel]], because they did not have knowledge of how to ward off the effects of Damotite [[Poison/Legends|poisoning]].<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Siege" />
